Focused on performance optimization (-15–40% LCP/TTI), interactive data & workflow visualization (XYFlow, D3.js), strict typesafe architectures, and AI-assisted engineering (Cursor, Claude, LLM workflows).

KnowledgeBase.howToAddTitle: How to add nested sections, subtopics, and articles:
